title: 品格教育：仁慈
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Kindness 品格教育：仁慈

slides.eyebrow_zh: 跟 Dom 老師上品格教育

strip.en: kind act starts the next one
strip.zh: 個仁慈的舉動，帶動下一個

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

slides.ask_en: Think of one person who was kind to you this week.
slides.ask_zh: 想一想：這個星期，誰對你很仁慈？

slides.body_en: Kindness means you see what someone needs — and you do something nice to help.
slides.body_zh: 仁慈，就是看見別人需要什麼——然後做一件好事幫助他。

prompts.en: Stand up if a friend shared something with you today.
prompts.zh: 今天有朋友跟你分享東西的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you helped someone this week.
prompts.zh: 這個星期有幫過別人的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you said “thank you” or “are you OK?” today.
prompts.zh: 今天有說過「謝謝」或「你還好嗎」的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: Kindness is already here at Lukang. Let's make it grow!
slides.punch_zh: 仁慈已經在鹿港國小了。我們讓它長得更大！

slides.note_en: Thumbs up for KIND, thumbs down for NOT KIND!
slides.note_zh: 仁慈比讚，不仁慈比倒讚！

slides.q_en: It is raining. Your friend has no umbrella. What can you do?
slides.q_zh: 下雨了，你的朋友沒有傘。你可以怎麼做？
slides.explain_en: Share it! One umbrella keeps two friends dry.
slides.explain_zh: 一起撐！一把傘，兩個朋友都不會淋濕。

slides.q_en: A classmate drops all her books. What is the kind thing to do?
slides.q_zh: 同學的書全部掉在地上。怎麼做才是仁慈？
slides.explain_en: Help! Many hands make the work light.
slides.explain_zh: 幫忙撿！大家一起，事情就變輕鬆。

slides.body_en: Lukang has an old lane less than one meter wide. When two people meet, one must step aside. That is why people call it Gentleman's Lane.
slides.body_zh: 鹿港有一條不到一公尺寬的老巷子。兩個人相遇時，一定要有一個人側身讓路。所以大家叫它「君子巷」。

slides.q_en: In Gentleman's Lane, you meet a grandma carrying a heavy basket. What is the kind thing to do?
slides.q_zh: 在君子巷裡，你遇到一位提著重籃子的阿嬤。怎麼做才是仁慈？

options.en: Step aside and let her go first

slides.explain_en: Step aside and smile. Letting someone go first is a small kindness anyone can do.
slides.explain_zh: 側身讓路，再加一個微笑。讓別人先走，是每個人都做得到的小小仁慈。

slides.ask_en: Look — this is your school! One jar alone is small. Hundreds of jars together make a wall. Kind acts work the same way.
slides.ask_zh: 看——這是你們的學校！一個甕很小，幾百個甕放在一起，就成了一道牆。仁慈的舉動也是這樣。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Kindness is only for my best friends.
items.zh: 只要對好朋友仁慈就好。
items.note_en: Kindness is for everyone — new friends, too.
items.note_zh: 仁慈是給每一個人的——新朋友也是。

items.zh: 一個微笑也可以是仁慈。
items.note_en: Yes! It is free, and it takes one second.
items.note_zh: 對！不用錢，而且只要一秒鐘。

items.en: Taking care of our garden is kindness.
items.zh: 照顧我們的花園也是仁慈。
items.note_en: We are kind to places everyone shares.
items.note_zh: 大家共用的地方，我們也要愛護。

items.en: Kindness is only for people you already know.
items.zh: 只要對認識的人仁慈就好。
items.note_en: Strangers, new classmates, grandmas in the lane — everyone!
items.note_zh: 陌生人、新同學、巷子裡的阿嬤——每個人都是！

slides.rule_en: Two friends act out a kind action — no talking! The class guesses in English.
slides.rule_zh: 兩位同學演出一個仁慈的動作——不能說話！全班用英文猜。
hints: share an umbrella 一起撐傘
help a friend up 扶朋友起來
share a crayon 分享蠟筆
water the garden 幫花園澆水
cheer for a friend 幫朋友加油
slides.target_zh: 我們能猜對全部六個嗎？

slides.prompt_en: What is one kind thing you can do at school?
slides.prompt_zh: 在學校，你可以做的一件仁慈的事是什麼？
slides.time_en: Thirty seconds each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人 30 秒。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.note_en: Watch closely — what do the friends share at lunch?
slides.note_zh: 仔細看——午餐時，朋友們分享了什麼？

slides.q_en: In Dom's cartoon, what did the friends share at lunch?
slides.q_zh: 在 Dom 的動畫裡，午餐時朋友分享了什麼？
slides.explain_en: A clean spoon! Kindness can be very small — and still matter a lot.
slides.explain_zh: 一支乾淨的湯匙！仁慈可以很小，卻很重要。

slides.head_zh: 今天就可以做的 3 件仁慈的事

items.en: Invite someone to play with you.
items.zh: 邀請一位同學跟你一起玩。

items.en: Share something — a crayon, a snack, a smile.
items.zh: 分享一樣東西——蠟筆、點心，或一個微笑。

items.en: Tell a friend: “You can do it!”

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Lukang Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — just write your comment for Teacher Dom.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到鹿港國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，直接留言跟 Teacher Dom 互動。

slides.big_en:

slides.big_zh: 一個仁慈的舉動，會帶動下一個。
